content.text: Do you crutch on 1.16.2 addreses for a specific reason?

I cannot rewrite the row yet: reading the 1.17.1 entry requires the game running, and starting the daemon requires sudo. The convention is not a crutch, it is the only named image this workspace has. The 1.17 dump carries zero curated symbols, so every function there is FUN_<addr>; names, types and RTTI live only on 1.16.2 and have to be carried across by pairing. That is why each row in the table starts from a 1.16.2 address and is mapped forward before use.
